notFound.title: That product is not here any more
notFound.text: It may have been deleted. Open it again from your products list.

name.label: Product name
name.hint: In English, with the place or variety if it matters: “Củ Chi water spinach”, “Green-skin pomelo”.

category.label: Category
category.hint: Categories are managed by the admin.

unit.label: Sold per
unit.hint: How a customer buys it: by the kilo, the bunch, the bulb, the bag. Pick one or name your own.

preview.label: How it will read
preview.text: {{price}} on the tag · {{left}} left · someone ordering one sees {{one}}

qty.label: Quantity available this week
qty.error: Quantity must be 0 or more. Use Sold out for none left.

shelfLife.label: Shelf life
shelfLife.shorter: Shorter than suggested. Customers see exactly this number.
shelfLife.ackLabel: I promise this still keeps well for {{days}} days when stored this way ({{storage}}). If a customer reports it spoiled before then, the admin can record a violation for the stall.
shelfLife.ackRequired: Tick the promise to save a longer shelf life.
shelfLife.tooLong_one: At most {{count}} day for this group.
shelfLife.tooLong_other: At most {{count}} days for this group.
shelfLife.saveBlocked: Tick the promise above to save.
shelfLife.saveNeedsGroup: Pick a storage group above to save.
shelfLife.saveNeedsGroups: Reload the storage groups above to save.
shelfLife.fallback: This category has no storage groups yet. It usually keeps {{min}}–{{max}} days.
shelfLife.groupGone: The group this product used is no longer offered. Pick another.

desc.label: Description
desc.hint: Shown on the product page. Say how it is grown and how to keep it.

photo.label: Photo
photo.uploadInProgress: Wait for the photo to finish uploading, then save.
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 8 MB. Close up, natural light, on wood or paper.

error.tooLarge: The photo must be 8 MB or smaller.
error.type: Photos must be JPEG, PNG or WEBP.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.text: It disappears from the catalogue and from your template. Orders that already include it are not changed.

image.label: Photo link
image.hint: Optional. A public link to a photo of the product; until then the tag shows the category in handwriting.
